name: app-dark-profile-and-passenger-phones-tilted-on-moon-rock
title: Dark Profile and Passenger Phones on Moon Rock
whatItIs: A dark slate slide with a rounded photo of two phones lying tilted on cratered grey rock, showing a dark Profile screen with account rows and a white Log Out bar and a Passenger Details form, with a Booking Info pill at the top corner.
whatItMeans: The lunar surface and steep tilt make a dark UI feel exploratory and cinematic.
techniques: Phones lying at an angle on textured rock
Dark UI with one white bar for the key action
Rounded photo panel on dark slate
Perspective distortion of text along the tilt

vocabulary.definition: A rough surface used as a staging ground.
Interface text skewed by a tilted device.
A white bar marking the main or final action.
